pts-core/phoromatic/pages/phoromatic_r_s.reason: Finds the account of the user just made by the console's create form, to send the administrator to its page; user names are unique across the server and the request is a server administrator's (checked at the top of the handler)

pts-core/phoromatic/pages/phoromatic_use.reason: User names are unique across the whole server (the login is by name alone), so this has to look at every account (adding a user checks the name is free); the name is bound or single-quoted and escaped, never a double-quoted value (the lint refuses those outright)
pts-core/phoromatic/pages/phoromatic_use.snippet: SELECT UserName FROM phoromatic_users WHERE UserName = '?'

pts-core/phoromatic/pages/phoromatic_wel.reason: Log-in: the user is found by name alone (names are unique server-wide) and the password is checked before anything about them is said; then their own row is stamped with the time and address.
pts-core/phoromatic/pages/phoromatic_wel.snippet: UPDATE phoromatic_users SET LastIP = :last_ip, LastLogin = :last_login WHERE UserID = :user_id

pts-core/phoromatic/public_html/phoromat.reason: Discovery for a client that sends no account id: the account that holds a live system with this machine id, answered only when exactly one active account does (two accounts that both know it name neither); the machine id is the client's own identity
